Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXV OF 2002
SINDH CIVIL
SERVANTS
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE 2002
ORDINANCE XXXV OF
2002
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 12th October, 2002]
No. S.Legis.1(35)/2002, dated
12-10-2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Civil Servants
(Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. In the Sindh Civil Servants
Act, 1973 after section 23, the following new sections shall be inserted:-

2. Insertion of section 23-A
in Sindh Act XIV of 1973.----"23-A. Indemnity.--No suit,
prosecution or other legal proceedings shall lie against a civil servant for
anything done in his official capacity which is in good faith done or intended
to be done under this Act or the rules, instructions or directions made or
issued.

3. Insertion of section 23-B
in Sindh Act XIV of 1973.--"23-B Jurisdiction barred.--Save as
provided under this Act and the Sindh Service Tribunals Act, 1973, or the rules
made thereunder, no order made or proceedings taken under this Act, or the
rules made thereunder by the Governor or any officer authorized by him shall he
called in question in any Court and no injunction shall be granted by and Court
in respect of any decision made, or proceedings taken in pursuance of any power
conferred by, or under, this Act or the rules made thereunder."
